observed.attributionRationale: Spire's purchase agreement identifies ISQ Global Infrastructure Fund III, L.P. as the buyer fund and equity provider for the Subterra acquisition chain, and the closing filing plus I Squared announcement establish the completed acquisition and Bear River platform launch. The named fund is not yet a curated Fund Database record, so no fund link is created; the disclosed 100% interest applies to Belle Butte LLC and is not promoted to an unsupported Bear River-level percentage.

Harrison Street acquired Cincinnati Zoo Solar through its Social Infrastructure Strategy, but the reviewed public sources do not identify a specific fund, managed account, upstream vehicle or ownership percentage.
